name: Unsummited
detailed_description:
Opening to testers!

Even though the game is still in a rough and uncompleted state, I am opening this up for requests to play the current buggy, unfinished, and broken version of the game. Enjoy, and please email our support with detailed descriptions of any issues you have along with your crash log and any suggestions you have.

- Scoopi


About the Game

A young and strange preteen aged kid with an unknown name emerges at the gates surrounding a large mostly standalone mountain known as Mt. Olzien. This mountain is mainly known for one special factor it holds: it seemingly has no summit. It is infinitely tall. Despite this claim, this kid wants nothing but to get to the top of the mountain, at any cost.

In Unsummited, pack your hikers bag and strap on your adventuring boots, 'cause you're in for a truly unforgettable adventure! Along your climb up the mountain, you will discover an engaging and thought out battle system involving fun and nostalgic arcade action mini-games, funny characters with witty dialogue, lots and lots of jokes, and a very compelling overarching narrative.

The NPCs of Unsummited consist of your run-of-the-mill humans, as well as a “race” of special creatures called “mountain dwellers”. They come in all shapes in sizes: from talking Wooden Logs to Walking Fish and Vegetables.
Unfortunately, though, this peace-loving people have been terrorized for years by the tyrannical King Greytol, hell-bent on total enslavement of them all, and erasure of any good they hold. It’s YOUR task to choose to help the struggling mountain dwellers in their time of need, or.. perhaps put them out of their misery before the king can get his chance to do them in for good...?

Good luck, adventurer! That is, if you choose to accept this mission...!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: If your card was made after the year 2004, I think you're fine
